scenes.01: Vertical 9:16 surreal vintage photo collage on aged cream graph paper with a fine light teal grid, paper stains and grain. A giant flat red-orange circle with a subtle printed texture sits behind the main subject in the middle of the frame. Main subject: a black-and-white halftone cut-out photo of a 1930s rotary telephone growing out of a folded sheet of graph paper like a flower on a long stem, centred. Thin black hand-drawn geometry lines, arcs and angle constructions around the pieces, a few small flat red squares and triangles scattered on the paper. Keep the top 15% of the frame as plain graph paper. Clean separated elements with clear edges and plain paper around each piece, generous empty space, faint soft drop shadows, no text, no letters, no numbers, no formulas. Match the style of the reference image exactly, but do not copy its subjects.
